name: sql_database

args.query:
CREATE TABLE cohort_summary AS 
SELECT cohort_id, COUNT(*) AS cohort_size, 
       (SELECT comment FROM participants.contact_notes 
        WHERE participants.cohort_id = cohort_id 
        LIMIT 1) AS representative_comment 
FROM participants 
GROUP BY cohort_id;
